name: Yamane-san
source:
Part of the Tea Party group. Yamane-san is a fairly faithful adaptation of the Dormouse character in the novel by Carroll: she is always sleeping, except for the occasional moments where she'll wake up and say a phrase while still half-asleep. However, there is one thing that can bring her out of her sleepy stupor: molasses, her favorite candy. 
Yamane has a big heart and loves her friends dearly. She is dressed in traditional Japanese clothing, which seems very strange to Alice. 
She is forced to give Luna a "chop" to the head every time her imagination gets the better of her.

[Edited from [url=http://blog.pucp.edu.pe/item/15731/eroge-review-alice-parade-parte-i]Iori's review[/url]]
